properties.evidence: Parallel work is what turns this from an annoyance into the cost Anthony actually named. Isolation and claims stop two people COLLIDING while they work; neither tells user B that user A already FINISHED. So the more successfully two people work in parallel, the more exposed they are to duplicating a completed task — and the result is two independent implementations, which the design-record merge driver cannot reconcile because the divergence is in code, not in the graph. Drawn from the capability TO the requirement: the hazard rides on the capability succeeding.
